Name: Freelancer
Description: Hire freelancers to get work done
Introduction: The Freelancer API is an online platform where businesses can connect with freelancers to get their work done. With a simple integration into your application, the API provides access to a wide range of features, including: 1) Search for freelancers with the required skills. 2) Post projects and receive proposals from freelancers. 3) Management of projects and payments. 4) Get real-time notifications on project updates. Whether it's a small task or a complex project, Freelancer API is an ideal choice for businesses looking for reliable and cost-effective solutions to meet their project requirements.
Functions:
1. Name: searchFreelancers
Description: This function allows businesses to search for freelancers based on their skills and other criteria.
Input: Required. JSON object with the following keys:
- keywords: String. Keywords related to the project.
- skills: String. Skills required for the project.
- country: String. Country where the freelancer is located.
- hourly_rate_min: Integer. Minimum hourly rate of the freelancer.
- hourly_rate_max: Integer. Maximum hourly rate of the freelancer.
Output: An array of JSON objects, each representing a freelancer. Each object contains the following keys:
- id: Integer. Unique identifier of the freelancer.
- username: String. Username of the freelancer.
- display_name: String. Display name of the freelancer.
- profile_picture_url: String. URL of the freelancer's profile picture.
- hourly_rate: Integer. Hourly rate of the freelancer.
- skills: Array of strings. Skills of the freelancer.
- country: String. Country where the freelancer is located.

2. Name: postProject
Description: This function allows businesses to post a project and receive proposals from freelancers.
Input: Required. JSON object with the following keys:
- title: String. Title of the project.
- description: String. Description of the project.
- skills: Array of strings. Skills required for the project.
- budget: Integer. Budget for the project.
- currency: String. Currency of the budget.
- duration: Integer. Duration of the project in days.
Output: JSON object representing the posted project. The object contains the following keys:
- id: Integer. Unique identifier of the project.
- title: String. Title of the project.
- description: String. Description of the project.
- skills: Array of strings. Skills required for the project.
- budget: Integer. Budget for the project.
- currency: String. Currency of the budget.
- duration: Integer. Duration of the project in days.
- status: String. Status of the project.

3. Name: getProject
Description: This function allows businesses to retrieve information about a specific project.
Input: Required. Integer representing the project ID.
Output: JSON object representing the project. The object contains the following keys:
- id: Integer. Unique identifier of the project.
- title: String. Title of the project.
- description: String. Description of the project.
- skills: Array of strings. Skills required for the project.
- budget: Integer. Budget for the project.
- currency: String. Currency of the budget.
- duration: Integer. Duration of the project in days.
- status: String. Status of the project.

4. Name: updateProject
Description: This function allows businesses to update information about a specific project.
Input: Required. JSON object with the following keys:
- id: Integer. Unique identifier of the project.
- title: String. Title of the project.
- description: String. Description of the project.
- skills: Array of strings. Skills required for the project.
- budget: Integer. Budget for the project.
- currency: String. Currency of the budget.
- duration: Integer. Duration of the project in days.
Output: JSON object representing the updated project. The object contains the same keys as the getProject function.

5. Name: getProposals
Description: This function allows businesses to retrieve proposals for a specific project.
Input: Required. Integer representing the project ID.
Output: An array of JSON objects, each representing a proposal. Each object contains the following keys:
- id: Integer. Unique identifier of the proposal.
- bidder_id: Integer. Unique identifier of the freelancer who submitted the proposal.
- bidder_username: String. Username of the freelancer who submitted the proposal.
- bid_amount: Integer. Amount proposed by the freelancer.
- bid_duration: Integer. Duration proposed by the freelancer in days.
- bid_time: String. Time when the proposal was submitted.

6. Name: acceptProposal
Description: This function allows businesses to accept a proposal for a specific project.
Input: Required. JSON object with the following keys:
- id: Integer. Unique identifier of the proposal.
- project_id: Integer. Unique identifier of the project.
Output: JSON object representing the accepted proposal. The object contains the following keys:
- id: Integer. Unique identifier of the proposal.
- bidder_id: Integer. Unique identifier of the freelancer who submitted the proposal.
- bidder_username: String. Username of the freelancer who submitted the proposal.
- bid_amount: Integer. Amount proposed by the freelancer.
- bid_duration: Integer. Duration proposed by the freelancer in days.
- bid_time: String. Time when the proposal was submitted.
- status: String. Status of the proposal.

7. Name: getNotifications
Description: This function allows businesses to retrieve real-time notifications on project updates.
Input: None.
Output: An array of JSON objects, each representing a notification. Each object contains the following keys:
- id: Integer. Unique identifier of the notification.
- type: String. Type of the notification.
- message: String. Message of the notification.
- time: String. Time when the notification was sent.
